## Problem

What is wrong or undecided today? State it concretely before proposing a
solution.

## Proposal

What should Deka do? Include enough detail that an implementation can be held
against this decision.

## Alternatives considered

What else was considered, and why is it not preferred?

## Consequences

What does this make easier, harder, or incompatible?
